sources.title: LLAMBO-2 frozen reference distribution
sources.methodology: Frozen source-native reference distribution used by the LLAMBO-2 campaign baseline; it is not an external benchmark observation.

sources.title: LFM2.5-8B-A1B model card
sources.methodology: LiquidAI official LFM2.5-8B-A1B model-card Knowledge and instruction following comparison table; IFEval column. The raw model-card bytes are not sealed by this ledger; the hash is normalized snapshot metadata.

sources.title: WritingBench official score.xlsx
sources.methodology: WritingBench official score.xlsx Overall; SHA-256 verifies the checked-in normalized 54-row identity inventory, not raw workbook bytes.

claims.claim: The normalized Liquid AI snapshot records a first-party IFEval comparison row for LFM2.5-8B-A1B, but it is not an exact OMLX target observation.
claims.change_condition: The pinned model-card revision or exact-target identity mapping changes.

claims.claim: The normalized WritingBench snapshot metadata records 54 official score rows but no matching target-family row for this frozen campaign.
claims.change_condition: The official WritingBench score.xlsx revision or exact-target identity mapping changes.
